fusions.name: Raw Arc
fusions.desc: Swings a wave of raw arcana off the edge, dealing 30 damage to everything within 4 tiles ahead of you. It ignores resistances.

fusions.name: Unravelling Thrust
fusions.desc: A thrust at an enemy up to 5 tiles away that deals 8 damage, rising to 1.3 times that at full reach, and leaves it [Exposed] for 5 seconds. Usable only on an enemy carrying one of your afflictions, and uses one of them up.

fusions.name: Draw from the Steel
fusions.desc: Restores 4 mana a second for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Mana into Muscle
fusions.desc: Each time you spend mana, your physical damage rises by 20% for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
